setup.title: First-time setup
setup.sub:
You only need to do this once.
After that, it keeps itself up to date from the game logs.
setup.dirHelp:
Finds the folder where Tarkov is installed.
It reads map and quest records from the Logs folder inside.
setup.questHelp:
Does the count match the quest screen in the game? (don't count daily and weekly tasks)
If a trader's count differs, you only need to check that trader.
Click a trader to see which quests are listed.
setup.addHelp:
If you reinstalled the game or the logs were deleted, quests you accepted earlier may be missing.
When you add one, its prerequisite quests are marked as completed automatically.
setup.hideoutHelp:
Look at the hideout screen in the game and click the current level of each station. It saves right away.
You can also change it later in the Hideout tab.

settings.noServer: Couldn't connect to the server. Make sure the program is running.
settings.resetConfirm:
Reset everything?

Hidden quests, hand-over checks, storyline progress, manually added quests, hideout levels and secured items, and your edition will all be deleted. This can't be undone.
settings.resetFailed: Couldn't reset. Make sure the program is running.
settings.title: Settings
settings.dirHelp:
The folder where Tarkov is installed.
Map and quest records are read from the Logs folder inside.
settings.editionHelp:
Your edition decides which hideout stations are already built at the start (also after a prestige).
Stash level, and the Cultist Circle for The Unheard.
settings.runningHelp:
Like Task Manager, it only checks whether EscapeFromTarkov.exe is running, by name.
It never touches game memory or files.
settings.setupHelp:
If you reinstalled the game or the quests don't match the game, open the first-time setup again.
Your selections are kept; only the game folder, quests and hideout levels are checked again.
settings.reportTitle: Report a problem · Suggest a feature
settings.reportHelp:
Please leave bugs and ideas in GitHub Issues.
⚠ Don't upload game log files. They contain your login information.
settings.resetHelp:
Hidden quests, hand-over checks, storyline progress, manually added quests, hideout levels and secured items, and your edition are all deleted and you start again from the first-time setup.
Only the game folder is kept. This can't be undone.
settings.langHelp: Language for the interface and game data (quest, item and map names). Changing it reloads the screen.
